messages:
alice: Heads up — new hire followed quickstart `pip install redwood` and ended up with an unrelated PyPI package. Their import resolved to the other project's wheel.

alice: Repro (venv):
```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install redwood
python -c 'import redwood; print(redwood.__file__, getattr(redwood, "__version__", "no-version"))'
```

alice: Printed a path under site-packages and version 0.3.1 (not ours).

dan: Right — distro name is `redwood-inference` but top-level package is `redwood`. If docs show the short name users can hit the wrong PyPI project. We should never show `pip install redwood` in any public quickstart.

priya: Also noticed type hints missing: our published wheel lacks `py.typed` so mypy/IDE don't pick up annotations. And AsyncClient import errors popped up because examples use `from redwood import AsyncClient` but AsyncClient is only available with extras or via submodule.

dan: Immediate plan: (1) update docs to `pip install redwood-inference` and `pip install "redwood-inference[async]"` for async samples; (2) cut a small patch that includes `py.typed` in package and adds `[project.optional-dependencies] async = ["httpx[http2]>=0.24"]`; (3) add packaging CI check to unzip wheel and assert `redwood/py.typed` exists.

priya: For ergonomics, top-level re-export of AsyncClient is low-friction: when extras are installed `redwood/__init__.py` can import and export AsyncClient. Also update examples to import `redwood.async_client` for clarity.

ci-bot: Created ticket PKG-900: "quickstart doc fix + include py.typed + extras + CI wheel check" assigned to dan.

dan: Will prepare hotfix branch. Also will grep repo for any stray `pip install redwood` and replace. I'll add a release workflow step: build wheel -> unzip -> assert 'redwood/py.typed' present.

alice: Thanks — I'll update the onboarding checklist and ping support to mark affected Sentry issues as addressed once patch is published. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: packaging CI started for refs/heads/fix/pytyped-hotfix (run #1023).

ci-bot: packaging CI passed: wheel contains redwood/py.typed. Pre-release 1.1.7 uploaded. :rocket:
